human_catalogue.general_description: This is a so-called biological (or balneological) page. For general information about these pages see here . The parchment has a tear at the bottom of the page which was stiched, but the thread has been removed. There is a small round hole in the right margin. It has the folio nr (82) in the upper right corner.
human_catalogue.illustrations: There are two nymphs in the left and right margin near the top of the page, connected by two tubes with a joining element. There are two more nymphs just below them, with a different type of connection. There is a green pool at the bottom of the page with a wavy outline, with several female figures. One nymph is standing in a separate blue pool.
